title: MappingDocument
description: **The positions-mapping document** (`<run_id>.positions-mapping.json`, format 1.0.0). Unsigned: the scorecard's signed block binds its digest and length. Field order is byte order (`det_json`).

groups.description: One entry per group the point's receipt selected, keyed by its id.

point_id.description: The recovery point the positions came from (the plan's `source.point`).

positions_sha256.description: The positions document's digest, as the point's signed receipt binds it.

run_id.description: The restore run this mapping belongs to (the scorecard's `run_id`).

active_at_capture.description: Whether the group had members when its positions were read: they may have moved after, so the review says so.

entries.description: One entry per position entry of the positions document, in its order.

group_type.description: The receipt's group type (`classic`, `consumer`, or `other`); absent when the receipt records none.

no_committed_position.description: Partitions the group had never committed on: they stay without a position on the target, so the consumer's `auto.offset.reset` behaves as it did on the source.

reason.description: `NotCaptured: <reason>` for a group the backup did not capture; it then has no entry (arm PMD-7).

position.description: The captured next-to-consume offset, when the backup read one.

reason.description: [`SELECTION_EXCLUDED`] on an `approximate` entry; an unavailable reason on an `unavailable` one; absent on an `exact` one.

skipped.description: Archived records the restore's selection excluded between the position and the record it maps to: present exactly on an `approximate` entry.

target_offset.description: The target offset to commit: present exactly when the class is not `unavailable`.

target_topic.description: The restored topic, when the restore restored this topic.
